2026-10-20CSACanadian Space Agency ActAppointment of an interim President of the Canadian Space AgencyApproval of the appointment by the Minister of Industry of Jean-Claude Piedboeuf of Saint-Bruno-de-Montarville, Quebec, to be interim President of the Canadian Space Agency, to hold office during pleasure for a term of six months, or until such time as a new President is appointed, whichever occurs first.N/A
subject: Appointment of an interim President of the Canadian Space Agency
precis: Approval of the appointment by the Minister of Industry of Jean-Claude Piedboeuf of Saint-Bruno-de-Montarville, Quebec, to be interim President of the Canadian Space Agency, to hold office during pleasure for a term of six months, or until such time as a new President is appointed, whichever occurs first.
